headline: 5 arrested for SB SI killed in Savar after trying to stop fight
summary: Special Branch Sub-Inspector Md. Altab Hossain was beaten to death in his sons' garment factory; his younger son was also severely injured.
details: Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested four suspects from Munshiganj in connection with the murder of Special Branch (SB) Sub-Inspector (SI) Md. Altab Hossain.
// a police officer had previously been arrested by police in a case filed by the victim's wife.
// Altab Hossain, who worked at the SB's Malibagh office in Dhaka, was killed on Saturday night in the Boro Deshi area of Aminbazar, Savar.
// The incident occurred when Altab attempted to intervene in a fight between a private car driver and a garage owner over a parking dispute.
// According to the family, Altab identified himself as a police officer, but the attackers continued to assault him, eventually forcing their way into his sons' garment factory.

// A group of 20 to 25 people allegedly stormed the factory, beating Altab with indigenous weapons and severely injuring his younger son, Ariful Islam, who was attacked with a heavy object to the head.
// Altab's eldest son, Shariful Islam, alleged that a group of people often gather near their factory to use drugs, and that a white private car frequently circles the area.
// Altab was declared dead upon arrival at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, while his son remains hospitalized.

headline: Man killed, another injured in shooting at Dhaka’s Jatrabari
summary: Assailants on motorcycles opened fire indiscriminately at a rickshaw garage, leaving one man dead and another wounded.
details: A man was killed and another injured after assailants opened fire in Dhaka’s Jatrabari on Sunday night. The incident occurred around 11:00 pm in Dhalpur Sardar Goli.

caption:
A midnight shooting in Jatrabari leaves one dead and another injured as gunmen on motorcycles open fire.

A man was killed and another injured after assailants opened fire in Dhaka’s Jatrabari on Sunday night. The incident occurred around 11:00 pm in Dhalpur Sardar Goli.

The deceased has been identified as 40-year-old Imran Hossain, while 32-year-old Zakaria was injured. Both were rushed to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).

According to Zakaria's wife, a group of seven to eight men wearing helmets arrived on four motorcycles and fired indiscriminately while the victims were sitting outside a rickshaw garage.

Doctors at DMCH declared Imran dead around midnight. Zakaria is currently undergoing treatment for bullet wounds to his left leg and right hand.

Police Inspector Md Habibur Rahman stated that Imran was shot in the head, and his body has been kept in the morgue for an autopsy.

Additional Deputy Commissioner Mohsin Masud told The Daily Star that police primarily suspect the shooting was linked to a drug-related dispute.
